$comment: The design system's declared intent, plus the narrow set of genuine exceptions.
Every exception needs a `reason` of at least 20 characters, and an exception that
matches nothing is a hard error — dead entries must be deleted, not left to rot.
This is deliberately not a baseline file: it cannot be regenerated from the
`aliases` are tokens intended to be exactly the same colour. Each group is a
deliberate statement that the sameness is the design, not an oversight.
`themeInvariant` are tokens that hold one value in both themes, because the
surface they paint never follows the theme — the immersive programme screens are
always dark. They belong to the dark palette alone.
`adjacent` are pairs designed to sit next to each other and differ subtly. They
are exempt from the near-duplicate threshold but must still clear the
side-by-side visibility threshold, which is what caught dark mode's identical
surface / surface-raised before it was fixed.
accent / accent-text match in dark mode only: accent-text is the accent darkened
to pass 4.5:1 as small text on light surfaces; dark surfaces already give the
accent 4.8:1 or better, so there it is the accent itself.

exceptions.reason: The four fills of Google's G mark. Google's brand guidelines forbid recolouring it, so these cannot follow our palette or our themes.
Attribute selectors matching colours Recharts hardcodes into its own markup. These are how we find its elements in order to restyle them, not colours we set.
